sections.title: Chapter 1 — Basics & Expressions

questions.question: What is the extension of a C source file?
questions.solution: C source files always use the `.c` extension.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid integer data types in C?
questions.solution: `int` and `char` are integer types in C (`char` behaves as a small integer).

questions.question: The value of `10 / 3` using integer division in C is ______.
questions.solution: Integer division truncates the fractional part: 10 / 3 = 3.

sections.title: Chapter 2 — Control Statements

questions.question: Which keyword is used for alternative execution in C?
questions.solution: `else` is used along with `if` for alternative execution.
